ticket.summary: Outdoor hose bib (1990s original) sprays from the handle when opened; worn stem/packing — replace bib, non-urgent, spigot kept closed.
mitigation_advice: Keep the spigot turned off until the visit
If it drips with the handle closed, close the indoor supply valve feeding that line (clockwise until snug) [PB-01]

quote_lines.description: Outdoor hose bib replacement (original 1990s bib, leaking at handle)

ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Faye — booked for Tuesday, Sept 1 at 10:30 AM. Your tech will replace the outdoor hose bib for the flat rate of $169, and we'll text when they're on the way. Keep the spigot closed until then, and thanks for texting us!
